name: Yuzu USD
oneLiner: yzUSD is Yuzu's KYC-gated base dollar on Plasma, minted 1:1 with USDT0; yield accrues through the separate syzUSD wrapper.
collateral: Overcollateralized by diversified on-chain DeFi yield strategies (leveraged loops, Pendle liquidity, Euler lending markets) deployed on Plasma chain; backed by >$1 in on-chain assets per yzUSD
pegMechanism: Eligible investors (accredited/institutional, KYC/AML required) mint/redeem at 1:1 with USDT0; peg maintained by overcollateralization and risk tranching via yzPP junior tranche absorbing first losses

oracleRisk.summary: Yuzu documents yzUSD as a pooled, overcollateralized product minted and redeemed against USDT0, with yzPP as a first-loss tranche; it does not describe borrower-owned collateral positions with oracle-triggered liquidations.

branchApplicability.rationale: Yuzu describes yzUSD as a senior pool tranche minted against pooled backing assets and protected by the separate yzPP first-loss pool. Minting, redemption, and loss absorption are pool-level operations rather than borrower-specific debt positions with collateral-ratio liquidations, so no liquidation-oracle branch applies to yzUSD.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yzUSD's only material deployment is native issuance on Plasma. DefiLlama still reports ~24 yzUSD on a legacy Monad LayerZero OFT (0x9dcB0D17eDDE04D27F387c89fECb78654C373858), but peers(eid) returns zero for all probed endpoint ids on the Monad OFT (re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 88919965) and Yuzu announced it replaced LayerZero with Chainlink CCIP as its exclusive cross-chain infrastructure. The dormant Monad residue is below Pharos deployment and route-materiality thresholds, so it is not promoted as an active catalog route.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge-route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-6 (lead usde-ethena)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Yuzu's official overview describes yzUSD as an overcollateralized DeFi-suite stablecoin, while its security documentation describes protocol-level threat response and the ability to block a malicious wallet or contract from interacting with the protocol. Those materials do not establish a dated holder-level blacklist or freeze function for the tracked Plasma token contract. The inherited status is retained for the reserve, custody, and protocol-control dependencies; no direct token restriction is asserted.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-1 (lead usde-ethena)
reserveReview.rationale: The Accountable attestation platform (TEE-attested, issuer-endorsed proof of reserve) publishes a per-position exposure split of yzUSD's $49.38M backing as of 2026-07-10T08:04:48Z, which supersedes the prior 50/20/20/10 undocumented strategy-category projection. Rows are grouped by failure domain and linked to tracked assets following the reviewed accountable-adapter coinId mapping, extended with direct USDS, Aave USDC, and USDT0 liquidity-buffer links that the adapter map leaves unmapped. The split covers 98.26% of backing assets; the uncovered 1.74% residual is carried as an explicit unmapped slice. Backing exceeds yzUSD supply ($44.55M) by 10.8%.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable exposure_split snapshot of 2026-07-10T08:04:48Z normalized to total backing assets; per-row published values grouped by failure domain, no estimates
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 2.11% tail of small disclosed positions (syrupUSDG, VBILL, PYUSD loops, Aave AUSD/GHO/RLUSD dust, and rest-of-assets) is not split into per-asset weights, and 1.74% of backing is not covered by any attestor exposure row.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: yzPRIME is Yuzu's own prime fund token, not a tracked third-party stablecoin dependency.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Other disclosed small positions (syrupUSDG, VBILL, PYUSD loops; Aave AUSD/GHO/RLUSD; rest)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The attestor reports these rows individually but each is below 1% of backing; they are grouped for materiality and cannot be linked to a single tracked coinId.
Total backing exceeds the sum of the attestor's published exposure rows by this amount; no constituent detail is published for the residual.

providers.name: Fordefi (institutional MPC wallets, policy threshold 4-of-n with default block)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-1 (lead usde-ethena)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Accountable dashboard evidences Fordefi MPC custody (default-block policy, threshold 4) over fifteen disclosed main wallets and seven RWA fund wallets across Ethereum, Monad, and Plasma, and reserves are deliberately deployed into third-party yield strategies rather than held inert. Legal segregation, insolvency treatment of strategy positions, and any off-chain custodial arrangements are not publicly documented.

mintAuthority.summary: yzUSD mints via Yuzu's eligible-investor primary-mint model: 40 EOA accounts hold MINTER_ROLE on the Plasma token (enumerated exhaustively at block 27578074). Upgrades run through a 48-hour timelock (delay 172800s) with a 4-of-5 proposer Safe; limit/restriction parameters are managed by a 3-of-5 Safe behind a 12-hour timelock. Collateral operations sit in a Fordefi MPC treasury workspace.

review.evidence: At Plasma block 27099366, yzUSD is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with implementation 0x32d7...5cfe and ProxyAdmin 0x6ccf...d2aa. ProxyAdmin.owner() is a 172800-second TimelockController proposed by a 4-of-5 Safe. LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE and RESTRICTION_MANAGER_ROLE are each currently held by a 3-of-5 Safe and a 43200-second TimelockController proposed by that Safe; both Safes have the same five EOA owners. This corrects the prior UUPS classification and the false claim that the 48-hour timelock was an unresolvable custom contract. The remaining blocker is narrower: historical MINTER_ROLE grants/revokes have not yet been exhaustively reconciled to a complete current holder set. MINTER_ROLE reconciliation completed 2026-07-20: full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history of the yzUSD token on Plasma (Routescan index) reconciled against per-account hasRole calls at block 27578074 — 40 live MINTER_ROLE holders, all EOAs (enumerated in the direct-minter control evidence).
